title: Derived direct image along a qcqs morphism preserves quasi-coherent cohomology
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Then the derived direct image $Rf_*:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] sends the full subcategory $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves [def-pc-derived-category] into $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$.

proof.text: Let $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ and fix $q\in\mathbf Z$. For each affine open $U\subseteq Y$, [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-affine-truncation-comparison] supplies an integer $n$ for which the restriction of $H^q(Rf_*E)\to H^q(Rf_*\tau_{\geq -n}E)$ is an isomorphism. Canonical truncation preserves quasi-coherent cohomology: use DerivedCategory.homologyProperty_truncGE for the property SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent. It contains zero, witnessed by the free sheaf on the empty type; the identity on that free sheaf is zero since freeHomEquiv has an empty target family. Thus the truncation lies in $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(X)$ and is bounded below by $-n$.

Apply [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-bounded-below-qcoh] to the truncation. Its q-th higher direct image is quasi-coherent, hence so is its restriction to $U$ by SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent_over. Transport this property through the inverse of the isomorphism in the previous step, using ObjectProperty.prop_of_iso. Since the affine opens cover $Y$ (iSup_affineOpens_eq_top), SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop gives quasi-coherence of $H^q(Rf_*E)$. This holds for every integer $q$, which is precisely the required schemeDerivedQCohProperty.
